audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Moses/Aaron roles, Pharaoh hardening, staff-serpent sign, Nile blood sign, magicians, and Pharaoh's refusal.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, See, I have made you as Divine to Pharaoh, and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

modern.text: The LORD answered Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה רְאֵ֛ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֖יךָ יִהְיֶ֥ה נְבִיאֶֽךָ

verses.restored: You shall speak all that I command you, and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel from his land.

familiar.text: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

modern.text: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה תְדַבֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ וְאַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֨יךָ֙ יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: But I myself will harden Pharaoh's heart, and I will multiply my signs and wonders in land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

modern.text: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I will multiply My signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,

original.text: וַאֲנִ֥י אַקְשֶׁ֖ה אֶת לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י אֶת אֹתֹתַ֛י וְאֶת מוֹפְתַ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Pharaoh will not listen to you, and I will put my hand upon Egypt and bring out my hosts, my people children of Israel, from land of Egypt by great judgments.

familiar.text: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

modern.text: Pharaoh will not listen to you. Then I will lay My hand on Egypt, and by mighty acts of judgment I will bring the divisions of My people the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

original.text: וְלֹֽא יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֲלֵכֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת יָדִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוֹצֵאתִ֨י אֶת צִבְאֹתַ֜י אֶת עַמִּ֤י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בִּשְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים

verses.restored: Egypt shall know that I am YHWH when I stretch out my hand over Egypt and bring out the children of Israel from their midst.

familiar.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

modern.text: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD, when I stretch out My hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out from among them.”

original.text: וְיָדְע֤וּ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּנְטֹתִ֥י אֶת יָדִ֖י עַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוֹצֵאתִ֥י אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִתּוֹכָֽם

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron did so; as YHWH commanded them, so they did.

familiar.text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

modern.text: So Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded them.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹתָ֖ם כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

familiar.text: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

modern.text: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. Aaron’s Staff

original.text: וּמֹשֶׁה֙ בֶּן שְׁמֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַֽהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן שָׁלֹ֥שׁ וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּדַבְּרָ֖ם אֶל פַּרְעֹֽה

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses and Aaron, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

modern.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, Give for yourselves a wonder, then you shall say to Aaron, Take your staff and throw it before Pharaoh; it will become a serpent/dragon.

familiar.text: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

modern.text: “When Pharaoh tells you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ you are to say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a serpent. ”

original.text: כִּי֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵכֶ֤ם פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם מוֹפֵ֑ת וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֧ח אֶֽת מַטְּךָ֛ וְהַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי פַרְעֹ֖ה יְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh and did so, as YHWH commanded; Aaron threw his staff before Pharaoh and his servants, and it became a serpent/dragon.

familiar.text: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

modern.text: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD had commanded. Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a serpent.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַשׂוּ כֵ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת מַטֵּ֗הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין

verses.restored: Pharaoh also called the wise men and sorcerers, and they also, the magicians of Egypt, did so with their secret arts.

familiar.text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

modern.text: But Pharaoh called the wise men and sorcerers and magicians of Egypt, and they also did the same things by their magic arts.

original.text: וַיִּקְרָא֙ גַּם פַּרְעֹ֔ה לַֽחֲכָמִ֖ים וְלַֽמְכַשְּׁפִ֑ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֨וּ גַם הֵ֜ם חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן

verses.restored: Each threw down his staff, and they became serpents/dragons; but Aaron's staff swallowed their staffs.

familiar.text: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

modern.text: Each one threw down his staff, and it became a serpent. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs.

original.text: וַיַּשְׁלִ֨יכוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַטֵּ֔הוּ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְתַנִּינִ֑ם וַיִּבְלַ֥ע מַטֵּֽה אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶת מַטֹּתָֽם

verses.restored: Pharaoh's heart was strong/hardened, and he did not listen to them, as YHWH had spoken.

familiar.text: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

modern.text: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said. The First Plague: Blood

original.text: וַיֶּחֱזַק֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Pharaoh's heart is heavy; he refuses to send the people.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כָּבֵ֖ד לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה מֵאֵ֖ן לְשַׁלַּ֥ח הָעָֽם

verses.restored: Go to Pharaoh in the morning; look, he goes out to the water. Stand to meet him on bank of Nile, and take in your hand the staff that turned into serpent.

familiar.text: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

modern.text: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.

original.text: לֵ֣ךְ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֞ה בַּבֹּ֗קֶר הִנֵּה֙ יֹצֵ֣א הַמַּ֔יְמָה וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִקְרָאת֖וֹ עַל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֑ר וְהַמַּטֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְנָחָ֖שׁ תִּקַּ֥ח בְּיָדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Say to him, YHWH, Divine of Hebrews, sent me to you, saying, Send my people so they may serve/worship me in wilderness; and look, you have not listened until now.

familiar.text: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

modern.text: Then say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to tell you: Let My people go, so that they may worship Me in the wilderness. But you have not listened until now.

original.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעִבְרִים֙ שְׁלָחַ֤נִי אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔י וְיַֽעַבְדֻ֖נִי בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְהִנֵּ֥ה לֹא שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַד כֹּֽה

verses.restored: Thus says YHWH: By this you shall know that I am YHWH. Look, I strike with staff that is in my hand upon waters in Nile, and they shall turn to blood/life.

familiar.text: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

modern.text: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD. Behold, with the staff in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will turn to blood.

original.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּזֹ֣את תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַכֶּ֣ה בַּמַּטֶּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדִ֗י עַל הַמַּ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיְאֹ֖ר וְנֶהֶפְכ֥וּ לְדָֽם

verses.restored: The fish in Nile shall die, and Nile shall stink, and Egypt will be weary of drinking water from Nile.

familiar.text: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

modern.text: The fish in the Nile will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians will be unable to drink its water.’”

original.text: וְהַדָּגָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹ֛ר תָּמ֖וּת וּבָאַ֣שׁ הַיְאֹ֑ר וְנִלְא֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן הַיְאֹֽר

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Take your staff and stretch your hand over waters of Egypt, over their rivers, canals, pools, and every gathering of their waters, and they shall become blood/life; there shall be blood/life in all land of Egypt, even in wood and stone vessels.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over their rivers and canals and ponds and reservoirs—that they may become blood.’ There will be blood throughout the land of Egypt, even in the vessels of wood and stone.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֡ן קַ֣ח מַטְּךָ֣ וּנְטֵֽה יָדְךָ֩ עַל מֵימֵ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם עַֽל נַהֲרֹתָ֣ם עַל יְאֹרֵיהֶ֣ם וְעַל אַגְמֵיהֶ֗ם וְעַ֛ל כָּל מִקְוֵ֥ה מֵימֵיהֶ֖ם וְיִֽהְיוּ דָ֑ם וְהָ֤יָה דָם֙ בְּכָל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבָעֵצִ֖ים וּבָאֲבָנִֽים

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron did so, as YHWH commanded. He lifted staff and struck waters in Nile before eyes of Pharaoh and eyes of his servants, and all waters in Nile turned to blood/life.

familiar.text: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

modern.text: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded; in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was turned to blood.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֤רֶם בַּמַּטֶּה֙ וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת הַמַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּיְאֹ֔ר לְעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיֵּהָֽפְכ֛וּ כָּל הַמַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹ֖ר לְדָֽם

verses.restored: The fish in Nile died, and Nile stank, and Egypt could not drink water from Nile; and blood/life was in all land of Egypt.

familiar.text: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

modern.text: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.

original.text: וְהַדָּגָ֨ה אֲשֶׁר בַּיְאֹ֥ר מֵ֨תָה֙ וַיִּבְאַ֣שׁ הַיְאֹ֔ר וְלֹא יָכְל֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן הַיְאֹ֑ר וַיְהִ֥י הַדָּ֖ם בְּכָל אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: But magicians of Egypt did so with their secret arts, and Pharaoh's heart was strong/hardened, and he did not listen to them, as YHWH had spoken.

familiar.text: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.

modern.text: But the magicians of Egypt did the same things by their magic arts. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵ֛ן חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּלָטֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְלֹא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and did not set his heart even to this.

familiar.text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

modern.text: Instead, Pharaoh turned around, went into his palace, and did not take any of this to heart.

original.text: וַיִּ֣פֶן פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל בֵּית֑וֹ וְלֹא שָׁ֥ת לִבּ֖וֹ גַּם לָזֹֽאת

verses.restored: All Egypt dug around Nile for water to drink, for they could not drink from waters of Nile.

familiar.text: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

modern.text: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river.

original.text: וַיַּחְפְּר֧וּ כָל מִצְרַ֛יִם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הַיְאֹ֖ר מַ֣יִם לִשְׁתּ֑וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לִשְׁתֹּ֔ת מִמֵּימֵ֖י הַיְאֹֽר

verses.restored: Seven days were fulfilled after YHWH struck the Nile.

familiar.text: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

modern.text: And seven full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile.

original.text: וַיִּמָּלֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים אַחֲרֵ֥י הַכּוֹת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הַיְאֹֽר

translation_notes: Tannin may be serpent/dragon; preserve mythic and Egyptian-symbolic resonance without overclaiming.
Hardening terms begin to alternate: here heavy/strong language should be tracked carefully in second-pass lexical audit.
Nile judgment confronts the river as imperial life-source after Pharaoh used it for death in chapter 1.
safety_note: The sign targets Pharaoh's oppressive refusal and Egypt's imperial system, not Egyptians as an ethnicity. Ecological harm in the signs should be read as apocalyptic/legal confrontation with oppression, not as celebration of suffering.
